compatibility: Additive and fail-closed; historical Part 1 validation remains frozen and passing.
decisions: PostgreSQL LSN halves are bounded to unsigned 32-bit hexadecimal text.
The exported slot consistent point is snapshot frontier S.
The first governed CDC frontier is the decoded transaction COMMIT LSN, not a row-change record LSN that may equal S.
Physical LSN values are run evidence and are excluded from semantic workload identity.
limitations: Proof is limited to isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 and local Python behavior.
No AWS DMS, Spark, Iceberg, Terraform, deployment, performance, availability, cost, RTO/RPO, exactly-once, zero-downtime, or production-readiness claim is established.
